title: Respond to cached or denied access
responsibility: Makes the shown project read-only when it goes offline and removes shared project content when access is denied.

inputs.name: offlineCapabilities.source
inputs.description: The original source, local or github, to retain while disabling all change actions for an offline view.

inputs.name: offlineView.snapshot
inputs.description: The snapshot whose cache information should be inspected. It counts as cached when its cache status is offline or its cache explicitly says read-only.

inputs.name: forgetShared.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace whose shared content and pending navigation may need to be invalidated. A displayed GitHub-backed project is cleared only when the event names it or the whole session.

inputs.name: forgetShared.projectId
inputs.description: The denied project identity, or the special value $projects for the entire session. Pending navigation is preserved only when its target is listed as a local project.

inputs.name: forgetShared.notice
inputs.description: The message to store as the workspace error when the shown shared project is removed.

inputs.name: cacheStatus.workspace
inputs.description: The workspace to update in place when a cache event arrives, including its shown project, pending target, project list and allowed actions.

inputs.name: cacheStatus.event
inputs.description: A project identity and fresh, offline or denied status, with an optional cached time. An offline event applies only to the shown project. A denied event removes affected shared content. A fresh event does not restore a cached view; that requires a newly loaded snapshot.

outputs.name: everyProject
outputs.description: The special project identity $projects, used for events about the complete session or project discovery.

outputs.name: deniedNotice
outputs.description: The message: Access to this shared project ended. Connect again or ask its owner.

outputs.name: offlineNotice
outputs.description: The message: Offline cached view. Comments and changes need a connection.

outputs.name: offlineCapabilities
outputs.description: Capabilities with comments, agents, planning and approval disabled, the supplied source retained, and the offline notice as the reason.

outputs.name: offlineView
outputs.description: The cached timestamp, or null when it was not recorded, wrapped as cached-view information. Returns null when the snapshot is not marked offline or read-only.

outputs.name: forgetShared
outputs.description: No return value. A session-wide denial removes shared projects from the list. Matching pending navigation is invalidated unless its target is listed as local. A matching displayed GitHub-backed project loses its snapshot, entity and cached view, receives closed capabilities and the notice, and triggers a project-list refresh for a single-project denial.

outputs.name: cacheStatus
outputs.description: No return value. A matching offline event marks the shown snapshot unwritable, records the cached time and disables change actions when first entering offline mode; existing cache metadata is updated. Denied events apply the shared-content removal rules. Other events leave the workspace unchanged.
